display_name: ICE Sideways Accumulation after High-Volume Drop
description: User-defined ICE entry detector: identify a large bearish price drop on abnormal volume, require more than 15 completed sideways sessions with accumulation evidence, then require two consecutive higher closes above the frozen sideways median.

deterministic_steps: Identify a shock session E where close-to-close return is at or below -3.0%, volume is at least 1.5 times the preceding 20-session median volume, and Close is below Open.
After E, observe a base of at least 16 completed sessions before confirmation can begin.
Freeze the base immediately before the two confirmation bars; the base excludes the confirmation bars.
Require base range width (maximum High minus minimum Low divided by median Close) to be no more than 8.0%.
Require the base close-price efficiency ratio to be no more than 0.30.
Require accumulation evidence: up-day volume divided by down-day volume at least 1.10 and OBV at base end not below OBV at base start.
Calculate the frozen sideways median as the median Close across the base.
Require confirmation day C1 to close above the frozen median and above the immediately preceding close.
Require confirmation day C2 to close above the frozen median and above C1 Close.
Emit one long entry intent after C2 closes; fill at the next trading session open under the shared execution model.

assumptions: ICE is treated as a custom user-defined composite because no governing ICE formula was supplied in the project sources.
The phrase 'big volume drop' is interpreted as a large bearish price drop occurring on abnormal volume, not merely a decline in volume itself.
More than 15 days is implemented as at least 16 completed trading sessions.
The sideways median value is the median daily Close of the frozen base, excluding the two confirmation bars.
No exit, stop, timeout or carry rule is owned by this strategy.
